
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/halfcode/p/19955613" title="发布于 2026-04-30 08:24">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">4. Token(词元)，5分钟彻底搞懂</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>Token（词元）是 AI 处理信息的最小单位。它既不是字，也不是词，而是由模型自行切分出来的 “文字碎片”。通常来说，1 个 Token 约等于 4 个字母，或 1～2 个汉字。</p>
<p>如果你习惯看视频，就看<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1K1dpBjEVg/" rel="noopener nofollow">《4. Token(词元)，看会动画敲下代码，就彻底搞懂了》</a>，喜欢看文章就接着往下看。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202604/1919157-20260430082101672-1293685876.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;Token的优化过程如下</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202604/1919157-20260430082130151-2058857315.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;大<span class="words-blog hl-git-1" data-tit="模型" data-pretit="模型">模型单次调用的总消耗 Token 由两部分组成：总消耗 Token = 输入 Token + 输出 Token。其中，输入 Token 的构成更为细致，包括当前用户提问 Token、系统提示词 Token、历史对话上下文 Token，以及消息格式开销 Token。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202604/1919157-20260430082150921-393757534.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>需要注意的是，Token 的实际切分由各模型厂商自研的 Tokenizer（分词器）独立完成，因此相同文本在不同模型上会产生不同的 Token 数量与序列。以上提及的换算比例等数据，均为行业通用估算参考。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202604/1919157-20260430082212247-557067815.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;下面通过代码实战，带你彻底搞懂。首先打开命令行窗口，使用&nbsp;<span class="words-blog hl-git-1" data-tit="pip" data-pretit="pip">pip&nbsp;命令安装 transformers和PyTorch 开发库。</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>pip install transformers torch</pre>
</div>
<p>安装完成后，我们便可以借助&nbsp;<span class="words-blog hl-git-1" data-tit="transformers" data-pretit="transformers">transformers&nbsp;库加载主流的分词器，直观地观察文本到 Token 的切分过程。以下是具体代码示例：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 首先从 transformers 库中导入 AutoTokenizer 类，它能自动适配不同大模型的分词规则</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> transformers <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AutoTokenizer
 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 接着从预训练权重加载 Qwen2 模型的分词器</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 注意： "Qwen2_tokenizer"是下载到本地自命名的分词器 ，下载地址见文章最后链接</span>
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Qwen2_tokenizer</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 定义待处理的输入文本</span>
text = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你好，我是cool。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ---------------------------------------------------------</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 第1步：分词 (Tokenization)</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ---------------------------------------------------------</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用 BPE算法将文本切分为“子词单元”</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 规则是：常见词为1个Token，复杂词会拆开，标点也算Token。</span>
bpe_codes =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tokenizer.tokenize(text)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 先打印出来看一下结果</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(bpe_codes)
 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 为了让分词结果可读，需要做一下处理</span>
decoded_result =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> []
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> bpe_code <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> bpe_codes:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 先将子词转换为模型词汇表中的ID</span>
    id =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids(bpe_code)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 再将单个ID解码回文本并将结果存起来</span>
decoded =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tokenizer.decode([id])
    decoded_result.append(decoded)
 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 输出最终的分词列表</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">分词结果：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, decoded_result)
 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ---------------------------------------------------------</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 第2步：向量化 (Numericalization)</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ---------------------------------------------------------</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 将字符串形式的 Token 列表转换为模型能处理的整数 ID 列表</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 这是大模型的“输入语言”（模型只认识数字，不认识文字）</span>
token_ids =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids(bpe_codes)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">向量ID：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, token_ids)
 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ---------------------------------------------------------</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 第3步：统计 Token 数量</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ---------------------------------------------------------</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 计算 Token 总数</span>
count =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> len(token_ids)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Token总数：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, count)
 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 将 ID 列表完整解码回原始文本</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">解码结果：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, tokenizer.decode(token_ids))</pre>
</div>
<p>Qwen2_tokenizer分词器下载：<a class="link-info" title="分词器" href="https://bcnz53uog6zq.feishu.cn/wiki/PZPLwlDk0iatMAkrH77cvosvnbg" rel="noopener nofollow">分词器</a></p>

</div>
